Title: NRA and cards that have multiple "actions" or "functions" on them...

Messages.Author: vermillian
Messages.Body:
So... a minion of mine governs at superior... he Changes the target,
or somehow untaps later, and he'd like to govern at inferior now...

Why can't I do that? I'm not repeating a type of action (Ie. bleed),
but I'm repeating what the action is called, the type of action I'm
doing is different.

I'm guessing I can't... which is lame. They're two different types of
actions...

Similarly, can Mr. Ventrue dude Govern at Superior, and then Scouting
Mission at superior. It'd be nice if the answer to this one was no,
but it'd be impossible to distinquish it from other similar actions
(One of the traditions... a presence card that does that, that 'new'
AUS DEM card).

Also... If I use Swallowed by the night at superior, and then Form of
Mist it to continue my action, can I play another Swallowed by the
Night at inferior (assuming I need the stealth)?

For that matter, can I play the Burning Touch action modifier that
makes dudes burn a blood to block, I continue the action he declines
to block and then play that same action modifier (but a different
effect) at superior to increase my bleed by one? That'd make this card
slightly less lame... :)

Thats all!

~SV

Messages.Author: The Lasombra
Messages.Body:
"vermillian" <vermil...@yahoo.com> wrote in message
news:f987c6cd.02022...@posting.google.com...

> So... a minion of mine governs at superior... he Changes the target,
> or somehow untaps later, and he'd like to govern at inferior now...
>
> Why can't I do that?

Because the action is the same. Only the results are different.
A Govern action influences vampires that are not controlled, adversely
for your opponent at inferior, in your favor at superior.

> I'm not repeating a type of action (Ie. bleed),
> but I'm repeating what the action is called, the type of action I'm
> doing is different.

Wrong.
The action is exactly the same.

> I'm guessing I can't... which is lame. They're two different types of
> actions...

They are two different effects. The action is the same.

> Similarly, can Mr. Ventrue dude Govern at Superior, and then Scouting
> Mission at superior.

Yes, he can.
They are different actions, and there is no type of action called
"move counters to an uncontrolled vampire".

> It'd be nice if the answer to this one was no,
> but it'd be impossible to distinquish it from other similar actions

Why?

> (One of the traditions... a presence card that does that, that 'new'
> AUS DEM card).

Govern, Freak Drive, Scout, Freak Drive, Fourth Tradition.
An eight point vampire for a few blood and cards played.
Sounds good to me.

> Also... If I use Swallowed by the night at superior, and then Form of
> Mist it to continue my action, can I play another Swallowed by the
> Night at inferior (assuming I need the stealth)?

Yes.
The superior is only a combat card.

> For that matter, can I play the Burning Touch action modifier that
> makes dudes burn a blood to block, I continue the action he declines
> to block and then play that same action modifier (but a different
> effect) at superior to increase my bleed by one?

No.
Burning Touch is an action modifier at both levels you mention here.

Carpe noctem.

Lasombra

section 3.19
